summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: On install, this package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the platform-specific `bun` executable to a temp directory, and then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, a shuffled 900+ entry string-array lookup table (`n7gIxM`), and a rotating decoder function (`WV8StW`) with randomly-named identifiers. Executing an opaque obfuscated payload under an alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based scanning of module loads. The bundled payload has no relationship to the package's advertised purpose (a React marketing-widgets component library), which has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime or a 727KB obfuscated install-time script. The lure-and-alternate-runtime-dropper shape is characteristic of a compromised or typosquatted publication under the `@servicetitan` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
